title: Open Mic @ Kulak's Woodshed
event_description: Weekly open mic night featuring singer-songwriters and musicians of all styles. Professional video and audio recording provided for all performers. Lottery-based sign-ups with approximately 25 performers selected.
venue_address: 5230 1/2 Laurel Canyon Blvd - North Hollywood - CA 91607
event_venue_information:
About Kulak's Woodshed

Kulak's Woodshed is a non-profit 49-seat professional recording studio and listening room that has been serving the Los Angeles music community since 1999. Founded by Paul Kulak and operated entirely by volunteers - this intimate venue is one of LA's most artist-friendly spaces.

Recording and Video Production

Every performance is recorded with 5 HD cameras and 24-track Pro Tools audio - providing performers with professional-quality video and audio recordings of their sets. The venue broadcasts all events live on the internet and maintains an extensive archive of performances.

Venue Atmosphere

The space features dark green walls adorned with vintage record albums - collectors' books - toys and bric-a-brac from bygone eras. A baby grand piano stands proudly in the center of the room. The venue offers a rustic-eclectic vibe with 90s living room aesthetics. Self-serve snacks - soft drinks - tea and coffee are available. The venue is pet-friendly and operates as an all-ages - alcohol-free space supported by audience donations.

Music Events

Beyond the Monday open mics - Kulak's Woodshed hosts ticketed performances throughout the week featuring both up-and-coming artists and seasoned professionals. The venue has become a treasured institution in the NoHo Arts District - known for its warm - welcoming atmosphere and supportive community of music lovers.

title: Vocal Jazz Jam @ The World Stage
event_description: Sunday evening vocal jazz jam session welcoming vocalists of all levels. Hosted by Rose Gales with house band. Bring charts when possible - though the band knows many standards.
event_venue_information:
About The World Stage

Founded in 1989 by legendary jazz drummer Billy Higgins and poet Kamau Daáood - The World Stage has become a pioneering institution in South LA's music and arts landscape. This 100-capacity venue serves as both an educational space and performance gallery in the heart of Leimert Park Village - Los Angeles' African American cultural community.

Mission and Programming

The World Stage's mission is to secure - preserve and advance African American music - literature and works in the oral tradition to local - national and international audiences. The venue provides affordable weekly workshops that link youth with elders in the African American cultural tradition.

Weekly Workshops and Jams

Throughout the week - The World Stage offers various workshops including Monday's Drum Workshop - Tuesday's Jazz Vocal Workshop - Wednesday's Anansi Writer's Workshop - Thursday's Billy Higgins Instrumental Jam Session - Saturday's Jazz Workshop and Trap Drum Workshop - and Sunday's Vocal Jam Session. Most workshops are offered for a suggested $5 donation - though no one is turned away for lack of funds.

Performance Space

The venue hosts ticketed performances on Friday and Saturday evenings featuring renowned artists from the jazz world. The space fosters exchange and interaction between artists of all ages and levels - providing a nurturing environment for self-discovery - experimentation and critical feedback. Notable alumni include B Sharp Jazz Quartet - bestselling authors - Pulitzer Prize nominees and acclaimed vocalists.

title: Tuesday Happenings Jam @ Sam First
event_description: Jazz jam session following a performance set by trumpeter Julien Knowles and The Happenings. Band performs at 7:30 PM followed by open jam from 9:00-11:00 PM. Use code SAM1JAM for jam participants.
venue_address: 6171 W Century Blvd #180 - Los Angeles - CA 90045
backline: House band - Yamaha C7x grand piano
event_venue_information:
About Sam First

Sam First is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit jazz club and cocktail bar located just minutes from LAX. Founded by owner Paul Solomon - the venue was designed to be unexpectedly creative - matching the authentic creativity of the musicians who perform there. The space features industrial interior structures - original photography and vintage mid-century modern furniture.

Performance Space and Acoustics

Sam First is designed without an elevated stage - removing the boundary between performers and audiences to promote collaboration and connection. The intimate listening room features amazing acoustics and one of LA's most loved Yamaha C7x grand pianos. The venue seats approximately 75-100 people in a configuration that makes patrons feel like they're on stage with the band.

Music Programming

The venue features world-class modern - eclectic and straight-ahead jazz artists five nights a week (Tuesday through Saturday) with two sets nightly at 7:30 PM and 9:30 PM. Tuesday nights feature The Happenings performance followed by an open jam session. The venue also hosts College Night - a program giving young musicians performance experience and networking opportunities.

Drinks and Atmosphere

Sam First offers a carefully curated selection of craft cocktails - local beers and wines - and bar snacks. The venue is also home to Sam First Records - a label documenting performances by resident and visiting artists. The club maintains a committed listening room policy - asking guests to refrain from talking during performances.

title: Jazz Sunday @ The Mint
event_description: Weekly jazz performances and jam session every Sunday. Features rotating selection of LA's best jazz musicians with open jam session led by Kevin Kanner starting after 9:00 PM. Musicians can join with drink ticket purchase.
venue_address: 6010 W Pico Blvd - Los Angeles - CA 90035
event_venue_information:
About The Mint LA

Established in 1937 - The Mint is a Los Angeles landmark with an incredibly rich music history spanning nearly 90 years. Located just east of Crescent Heights Boulevard on Pico - this intimate venue has been a cornerstone of LA's live music scene for generations.

Historical Significance

The Mint has hosted an astounding roster of legendary artists who either played or broke at this venue. Musical icons including Stevie Wonder - Willie Dixon - Natalie Cole - Ray Charles - Leo Nocentelli and Herbie Hancock have graced the seasoned stage. More recent performers include Ben Harper - Macy Gray - Billy Bob Thornton - The Wallflowers - Bonnie Raitt and Jackson Browne - along with surprise visits from Johnny Depp and George Clinton.

Venue Design

Acoustically engineered as a recording studio - The Mint offers patrons a profoundly excellent listening experience despite its intimate size. The venue features low ceilings - excellent sight lines and comfortable seating. The space maintains the down-home - funky atmosphere that has made it a comfy gathering place for music lovers since the 1950s.

Music Programming

While The Mint hosts various genres including soul - folk - blues and rock throughout the week - Jazz Sunday has become a beloved 20-year tradition. The venue continues to serve as a prime location for discovering new talent while honoring its legacy as a place where musical history is made. Full bar and restaurant service available during all shows - with the added bonus of ample free street parking.

title: Bluegrass Jam @ Oracle Tavern
event_description: Monthly bluegrass jam session on the second Thursday of each month. Acoustic instruments welcome. Located just outside Chinatown in downtown Los Angeles.
venue_address: 1640 N Spring St - Los Angeles - CA 90012
event_venue_information:
About Oracle Tavern

Oracle Tavern is a welcoming neighborhood bar located just outside of Chinatown in downtown Los Angeles. The venue has become a gathering spot for bluegrass musicians and enthusiasts in the LA area.

Bluegrass Community

The monthly bluegrass jam follows traditional jam session etiquette with musicians taking turns leading songs. The sessions welcome players of all skill levels playing acoustic instruments including banjo - fiddle - guitar - mandolin - dobro and upright bass.

Atmosphere

Oracle Tavern provides a casual - friendly environment for musicians to connect and play traditional bluegrass - old-time and country classics. The venue offers full bar service and has become an important part of Southern California's bluegrass community - providing a regular gathering place for pickers in the Los Angeles area.

title: Bluegrass Jam @ George Izay Park
event_description: Free outdoor bluegrass jam session every Sunday afternoon. All skill levels welcome. Bring your own acoustic instruments. Features banjos - fiddles - guitars - mandolins - dobros and more.
venue_address: W Clark Ave & N Griffith Park Dr - Burbank - CA 91506
event_venue_information:
About Burbank Bluegrass Jam

The Burbank Bluegrass Jam takes place every Sunday afternoon under the sycamore trees at George Izay Park. Started in May 2024 by guitarist Mark Gusick - this free outdoor jam has quickly become a beloved community tradition.

Jam Format

The session follows typical bluegrass etiquette with musicians sitting in a circle and taking turns leading songs. The setlist includes a mix of old-time - bluegrass and country classics like Will the Circle Be Unbroken - Old Joe Clark - Arkansas Traveler and Wildwood Flower. Participants play banjos - fiddles - double bass - piano accordion - Dobro resonator and acoustic guitars.

Community Spirit

The jam welcomes musicians of all ages and skill levels. Recent participants have included a 12-year-old fiddle player - visitors from Scotland and local musicians from throughout the San Fernando Valley. Some participants also enjoy flatfoot dancing on wooden dance boards. The group continues to grow each week - creating a welcoming environment where bluegrass enthusiasts can share their love of traditional American music.

Additional Information

Organizer Mark Gusick and his wife Margo also lead the Americana acoustic band Wild Rust - whose version of Wildwood Flower has been featured regularly on KXLU 88.9 FM's The Wildwood Flower Radio Hour.
